import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    nbInsert = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        c = s[i]
        j = i
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == c:
            j += 1
        length = j - i
        if length % 2 == 0:
            nbInsert += 1
        i = j
    
    print(nbInsert)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
